optional: region: Global only for actual available native parents

requestContract.unsupported: Unexpected selectors, unavailable drivers/gases/sectors, non-native producer families, missing/corrupt material, changed code/model/member/seed/result, and non-Global regions refuse without fallback.
requestContract.identity: Parent result/manifest/material/source archive/model/ordered snapshot hashes are retained verbatim. Derived codeHash and derivation.id are distinct from parent identity; rows, selection, member and seed enter derived hash.
requestContract.sensitivityComparison: Target minus the same target with one changed driver group reverted to chosen baseline; revertedDriverNativeMt is explicit. These values are not additive contributions.
requestContract.baseline: constant-activity-control as defined in exact supported captured native engine source; deliberately not presented as another retained headline.
